title: Trypophobia Accessibility Project
description: Changes textures from Minecraft and many mods for trypophobia accessibility
body:
# Trypophobia Accessibility Project

Changing textures to be more accessible to players with trypophobia since 2026

## Mods Supported

*   Biomes O' Plenty

### Upcoming Support

*   Alex's Caves
*   Architect's Palette
*   Create
*   Hybrid Aquatic
*   Minecraft

Permission was obtained from MysticKoko to reuse and modify Hybrid Aquatic's textures
